title: 環境土木専門実験・演習Ａ
subtitle: Civil and Environmental Engineering Major Lab/Exercises A
teachers:
TAKAHARA Toshiyuki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Students will learn skills that relate to actual phenomena, and apply those skills through experiments and exercises illustrating structural mechanics, soil mechanics, and reinforced concrete engineering.
advice:
We will cover the following topics:
1. Beam design (6 weeks)
2. Soil characteristics (5 weeks)
3. Behavior of reinforced concrete beams (3 weeks)
4. Overall across-field exercises (1 week)

Details of the schedule are explained during the first lesson.
Because references to reports etc. are properly distributed via an e-syllabus, students are expected to download them.

requiredKnowledge:
1. Allowable stress design method, various values of material sections, section force calculation, the relation between stress and strain, and bending deflection attitude
2. Relationship between consistency limits and consolidation, proper specification method for soil parameters
3. Concrete mixture proportions, compressive strength, bending of reinforced concrete beams
